name: One phone photo, four styled product shots
object: Shopify's AI photo editor, which turns one plain product photo into styled, ready-to-sell images from a typed prompt
audience: small brand owners and sellers who can't afford a studio photoshoot for product photos
message: This video tells sellers that a single quick phone photo of a product can become a professional, styled product photo in seconds, just by typing the scene they want.

moments.what: a phone camera viewfinder frames a plain black cap sitting on a bare surface, a finger hovering over the shutter button
the captured photo opens in an AI photo editor; the seller types a prompt asking to place the cap on a reclaimed-wood table in a cozy office, then taps generate while the app processes
moments.copy: show the hat on a reclaimed wood table in a cozy office

moments.what: the generated result appears instantly: the same cap now sits styled on a sunlit wood table in a warm, lived-in room, with no studio or reshoot involved

a second typed prompt asks for a flat lay of the cap surrounded by complementary props on a sunlit concrete surface outdoors; the result appears with the cap laid out next to sunglasses, a denim jacket and a small plant, showing the tool can produce a full set of different scenes from one original photo
moments.copy: create a flat lay of the hat surrounded by complementary items on a concrete surface, outdoors, bright natural daylight

cta: there is no spoken or written call to action; the video closes on the finished flat-lay image itself, letting the before-and-after transformation make the pitch to try the tool in the Shopify app
why: Showing the actual typed prompts and the generated results back to back, twice, proves the feature works without anyone saying a word; the viewer watches a plain cap on a desk become two different ad-ready scenes in under 25 seconds. The silent, screen-recording format fits the vertical feed and lets the speed of the transformation be the whole argument.
